cards.say: The missing number divided by six equals seven. Forty two. The inverse of dividing is multiplying: seven times six equals forty two.
Fifty six divided by the missing number equals eight. Seven. Eight times seven equals fifty six.
Fifty divided by seven. Seven remainder one. Seven times seven equals forty nine, and fifty take away forty nine leaves one.
Forty five divided by eight. Five remainder five. Eight times five equals forty, and forty five take away forty leaves five.

Seventy five divided by nine. Eight remainder three. Nine times eight equals seventy two, and seventy five take away seventy two leaves three.

cards.front: What is the inverse of dividing?
cards.say: What is the inverse of dividing? Multiplying. If six times nine equals fifty four, then fifty four divided by nine equals six.
